environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'search-prod' behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a route /health and /debug/status. The API Gateway has a request validation configuration with a JSON schema model bound to the query string parameters via a 'RequestValidator' resource (ValidateRequestParameters: true). The schema enforces that 'service' must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}$ and 'msg' must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9 ]{0,128}$. The VPC Link routes to an internal NLB target on port 8080. The pod's port 8080 is NOT exposed via any public-facing Service — only accessible through the internal NLB connected to the API Gateway VPC Link. A Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts ingress on port 8080 to source CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 (VPC internal only). The gRPC port 50051 is exposed only via a ClusterIP service for internal mesh traffic.
